title: 第140章 他好高兴
slug: 我在战锤抽词条帝皇站起来了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

基里曼站在扑倒在地的卡班哈面前，帝皇之剑的剑尖垂向地面。

整个战场突然变得鸦雀无声。

不管是人类还是恶魔，所有人都在看着擂台中央这一幕。

战士们停止了战斗，恶魔大军也不再嘶吼，一切都陷入了诡异的寂静，没有人再动。

“……”

所有人都看着原体蓝金色的身影和他脚边那个扑倒在地的巨大败犬，安静如鸡。

胜负已分。

卡班哈还在不停撑地尝试爬起来，但却怎么也没办法再撑起沉重的身体，最后只能侧着脸趴在地上。

它燃烧的巨眼盯着普兰迪姆天边灰蒙蒙的天空，喃喃自语，像是在骂人，又像是在呼唤它主人的名字。

血神——请赐予我对敌之力——

但是这次的呼唤没有得到回应。

黄铜王座没有给它支援。

血神的注视也在这一刻移开了。

因为它在与人类原体的单挑中输了。

血神也不再属意它，它失去了血神的恩宠。

对于血神信徒来说，这简直是天崩地裂了。

卡班哈倒在地上奄奄一息，两片翅膀被砍得干干净净。

胜负已分。

大魔瘫在岩壳上喘气，岩浆般的血液从它胸口的灼痕里渗出来，把地面烧得滋滋冒烟。

基里曼看了倒地的卡班哈一眼。

然后他举起了帝皇之剑，将帝皇之剑对准了卡班哈的头颅，居高临下地俯视着这个曾经不可一世的大魔：“去消散之地等着恐虐吧，恶魔。”

别急，你以后还有的是喊血神的机会，早晚把你家主子也送下去见你。

卡班哈眼睁睁地看着帝皇之剑刺下来。

它想抬起手去挡，但胳膊已经废了，从肘关节以下像被烤焦一样搭在地上，再也抬不起来。

它勉强从喉咙里挤出一声沙哑的咆哮：“竖子……尔敢！”

一开始看着帝皇之剑砍下来卡班哈还存有一丝希望，因为它被放逐就会回亚空间。

没关系，没关系没关系没关系。

帝皇之剑可以灼烧恶魔灵魂，但是毕竟不是握在帝皇手上。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Guilliman stood in front of Kabanha who fell to the ground, the tip of the Emperor's sword hanging to the ground.

The entire battlefield suddenly became silent.

Whether they are humans or demons, everyone is watching this scene in the center of the ring.

The soldiers stopped fighting, the demon army stopped roaring, everything fell into an eerie silence, and no one moved anymore.

"..."

Everyone looked at the blue-gold figure of the original body and the huge defeated dog that fell to the ground at his feet, as quiet as a chicken.

The outcome has been decided.

Kabanha was still trying to get up, but he couldn't support his heavy body anymore, and finally he could only lie on the ground with his face sideways.

Its huge burning eyes stared at the gray sky on the horizon of Plandim, muttering to itself, as if cursing, or calling its master's name.

Blood God—please grant me the power to fight against my enemies—

But this time the call went unanswered.

The Brass Throne gave it no support.

The Blood God's gaze also moved away at this moment.

Because it lost the duel with the human Primarch.

The Blood God no longer cares about it, and it has lost the Blood God's favor.

For Blood God believers, this is simply earth-shattering.

Kabanha fell to the ground dying, and his two wings were chopped off cleanly.

The outcome has been decided.

The big demon was paralyzed on the rock shell and gasping for breath, magma-like blood seeping out from the burn marks on its chest, burning the ground until it was smoking.

Guilliman glanced at Kabanha who fell to the ground.

Then he raised the Emperor's Sword, pointed it at Kabanha's head, and looked down at the once arrogant demon: "Go to the Disappearance Land and wait for Khorne, demon."

Don't worry, you will still have the opportunity to call the Blood God in the future. Sooner or later, your master will be sent down to see you.

Kabanha watched helplessly as the Emperor's Sword struck down.

It wanted to raise its hand to block it, but its arm was already useless. It lay on the ground from the elbow joint down as if it had been scorched, and it could no longer be lifted up.

It barely managed to squeeze out a hoarse roar from its throat: "Shu Zi... how dare you!"

At first, watching the Emperor's Sword chop down Ka'banha, there was still a glimmer of hope, because it would return to the warp after being banished.

It's okay, it's okay, it's okay.

The Emperor's Sword can burn demon souls, but it is not held by the Emperor after all.
